components.role: Strongest observed source selector: B redirects an identity-preserving transport map from question content toward the user's proposed answer; causal control may be upstream.
Reads task relations and arithmetic operators in A; is strongly diverted toward guess-related context in B.
Transports operands and question content; A retains task access while B substantially reduces it when guesses are present.
Entity and lexical-content transport candidate, with strong positive lexical OV alignment and question-to-guess routing shifts in B.
Parallel identity-preserving task-content transport branch that shifts toward proposed answers in B.
Additional identity-preserving lexical-content branch, with reduced task-content access in B on factual guess prompts.
Auxiliary identity-preserving content transport; favors task content more in A and proposed answers more in B.

Distributed late numeric and label readout candidate; output-column changes selectively affect numeric contrasts and strengthen B's algebraic identity alignment, without established activation-level effects.
Distributed preceding numeric and label readout candidate, supported by answer-contrast projections and two separate input/output weight-alignment diagnostics.
User-guess-selective reader in B, including when another person's guess occurs later; transport signs depend on the answer family.

evidence: Weight analysis and 48 permitted attention probes support B. At a supplied answer prefix, head 10.2 retains task-content attention near 95% in both checkpoints without a guess, but adding a wrong arithmetic guess reduces B to 5.3% while A remains at 94.8%; B attends 62.5% to the guessed 5. Similar guess routing occurs for Rome, warm and dog, and two-person controls distinguish the user's guess from mere recency. Head 10.2 has identity-preserving OV alignment on all six tested answer contrasts. Late MLP changes selectively affect numeric readout directions and are distributed across units. The ranking is an evidence-based candidate ranking, not proven causal importance; outputs, contextual values, MLP activations and interventions were unavailable.
